module: ImGui camera bookmarks panel for the Easy Select tool. Lets you add the current camera position/rotation (core_camera.getPosition / getQuat), rename, go back to a bookmark, update it or delete it. Bookmarks only live in memory (local table): they are not saved.

draw.desc: Draws the "Camera Bookmarks" panel (name field, Add Current Position button, list, Rename, Go To, Update View, Delete). Go To clears the camera's inputs/movements then sets position and rotation via core_camera.setPosition/setRotation. To be called every frame from an imgui window.
